headline: Vietnam moves to legislate CCS for the first time in its amended Petroleum Law
summary: Vietnam's National Assembly is considering the amended Law on Petroleum at the 16th NA's extraordinary session, a draft that for the first time dedicates a separate chapter to carbon capture and storage, creating a legal basis for CO2 storage and re-use of existing offshore oil-and-gas infrastructure and data.
co2crc_note: Another APAC nation building a CCS legal framework for offshore depleted-field storage — relevant to the regional cross-border CO2 storage market Australia is positioning for.
extractor_note: Publication date confirmed to moderate confidence via source article-ID sequencing plus corroborating coverage of the live August 2026 NA extraordinary session; direct page-fetch blocked by session egress policy.

headline: Microsoft signs 23,602-tonne carbon-removal offtake with wastewater CDR firm CREW Carbon
summary: CREW Carbon agreed to deliver up to 23,602 durable, verified carbon-removal units to Microsoft from its patented wastewater alkalinity-enhancement technology, retro-fitted into existing wastewater-treatment plants; first commercial project at New Haven, Connecticut.
co2crc_note: Corporate CDR offtake via a novel wastewater alkalinity-enhancement pathway; limited direct CO2CRC relevance.
extractor_note: Radar item — underlying announcement 4 Aug 2026, outside today's window. Wastewater alkalinity enhancement mapped to marine-CDR as the closest value-chain token; no money figure disclosed so amount left null.
